messages:
maria_ae: MercuryData requested a compact performance POC to validate p95/p99 at 200 qps and a short 60s spike to 1k qps. They care about tail latency, GPU util, and a cost-per-1M-token estimate. Can we confirm plan + deliverables?

sam_soleng: We can run from sales-dedicated-4. Need model + typical prompt/reply sizes, streaming preference, and KV cache policy. Also ask if cold-starts should be included.

maria_ae: Model = open-llama-7b, prompt ~300 tokens, reply ~100. Streaming=true. KV cache mem-only, zero persistence. Include cold-starts at ~5% of traffic. They want results within 24h and a 20-30m exec readout after the run.

jordan_ml: I'll prepare two replay sets: "long-context" (300/20) and "long-reply" (80/260) and a small cold-start file. Uploading to s3://redwood-poc/mercury/1791234567/. Will include README with seeds.

sam_soleng: Proposed compact run plan:
```
- Warmup: 10m @ 25 qps (compile + cache fill)
- Ramp: 20m -> 200 qps
- Steady A: 2h @ 200 qps (long-context)
- Spike: 60s @ 1000 qps
- Recovery: 10m @ 50 qps
- Steady B: 2h @ 200 qps (long-reply, includes 5% cold starts)
- Cooldown: 10m @ 10 qps
```
We can run in one 5.5h window.

maria_ae: MercuryData prefers Tue 2026-03-10 09:00-15:00 PT. Can we book infra and confirm? They want token-level cost and a short break-even calc for 3/6/12mo commits.

ravi_product: I'll produce cost-per-1M tokens for Hosted PAYG and Reserved commit scenarios. Need measured tokens/sec and effective GPU hours from the run to finalize. I'll draft assumptions ahead of the run.

alyssa_security: Security constraints: no prompt text in persistent logs, KV cache mem-only and cleared between sessions, recommend customer-managed KMS for production. For demo we can use Redwood-managed but document retention and redaction. I'll prepare a 1-page security memo and questionnaire answers.

sam_soleng: Draft run command (will finalize pre-run):
```
./loadtest --endpoint=https://dedicated.sales.redwood/v1/generate \
  --model=open-llama-7b --qps=200 --duration=14400 --streaming=true \
  --replay=s3://redwood-poc/mercury/1791234567/long-context.json \
  --kv-cache=memonly --prom=http://prom:9090 --coldpct=5 --redact-logs
```
I'll pin nodes and ensure no egress except results bucket.

deploy-bot: Reservation requested: pool=sales-dedicated-4, nodes=4, window=2026-03-10T09:00:00-15:00:00-08:00. Status: pending ops.

ops-bot: Ops note: will disable host swap, mount ephemeral NVMe for temp files, and restrict S3 egress to s3://redwood-poc/mercury/1791234567/results.

jordan_ml: Metrics to capture: p50/p95/p99 request latencies, tokens/sec, tokens/request, GPU mem/SM util, kernel time breakdown, and compile times for cold-starts. I'll provide Grafana panels and PromQL.

ravi_product: Deliverables post-run: 1) Exec summary with SLO pass/fail and cost-per-1M tokens, 2) Detailed appendix with latency histograms and GPU util, 3) Pricing break-even table (3/6/12mo), 4) Security memo, 5) Raw metrics tarball. Aim to deliver within 24 hours.

maria_ae: Action items recap: @sam_soleng finalize infra & final command, @jordan_ml upload replays + dashboards, @alyssa_security draft security memo + questionnaire answers, @ravi_product assemble report. I'll confirm with MercuryData when reservation is approved.

sam_soleng: No infra blockers on our side. I'll post final commands and PromQL 2h before the run in #eng-infra.

jordan_ml: Replays + README will be uploaded by EOD Friday to s3://redwood-poc/mercury/1791234567/.

maria_ae: Thanks team :rocket: 44d. Please update this thread with artifacts and I'll schedule the exec readout.
